next_method_recommendation.controlled_scenario_use: A transparently corrected, fully crossed bank can support planted format/item-effect sensitivity worlds once its structural and automated gates pass. It must be labelled a controlled measurement scenario until external validation is collected. The current five-family subset is too sparse (seen Q rank 3) for ontology-wide confirmatory claims.
next_method_recommendation.expert_validation_requirement: Before calling a successor bank deployable or platform-validated, render the learner interaction and obtain independent language-teacher/measurement and product review, followed by a small learner answerability pilot. Automated passing is stress-test evidence only.
next_method_recommendation.release_validity: Dataset release additionally requires all 38 families, 152 slots, full seen rank, both probes, executable scoring, and external rendered-item validation. Declared correction can repair construction evidence; it cannot by itself establish human answerability or platform deployability.
next_method_recommendation.smallest_scientifically_defensible_metho: Create a separately versioned declared-correction layer for the 33 exhausted whole families. Link every edit to its raw candidate and an explicit failure; prohibit silent repair and cross-round format cherry-picking; then rerun deterministic reconstruction, both solver replicates, and all three role critics. Do not spend another blind no-feedback generation round under the exhausted v0 protocol.

dialogue_reconstruction_preflight.interpretation: One valid structured generation exposed that a visible Speaker: label was being compared as part of the target utterance. The preflight stopped before solver or critic judgment; v0_2 explicitly declared and froze the interface-metadata exclusion.

provider_schema_preflight.interpretation: The provider rejected a dynamic const-only property without an explicit type. All three byte-identical retries failed before an inference result, so this run contains no item-quality evidence.

release_gate_failure.interpretation: The successful v0_2 execution is a negative construction result: the strict whole-family protocol did not yield a releasable bank. The five passing families remain evidence/examples, not a partial 152-item release and not a full-rank confirmatory instrument.
